title: Boundary fixed points in rank-zero Hénon components
exact_target: Prove that a boundary limit fixed point of an invariant rank-zero stable component has an eigenvalue equal to one.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300080 (AMR-052-0080). CC BY 4.0.
